verdict.rationale: Exporting all account data in open formats is a fair question for a payments and POS product, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documented data export, CSV or bulk download, or data-portability feature. The general API, the receipt data available via the API, and the Dashboard analytics filters are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not an export-and-leave capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
